title: Lost Adventurer's Satchel
description: Half-buried beneath rotting leaves, a leather satchel lies forgotten. Dark stains mark one side — blood or mud, you cannot tell. The brass buckles are tarnished but intact. Whoever owned this never came back for it.

choices.label: Search thoroughly
choices.description: Take time to check every pocket.

outcomes.text: Inside you find a few scattered coins and a carefully wrapped herb bundle. Not bad for someone else's misfortune.
The satchel holds a full coin purse and a sealed healing salve. This adventurer was well-supplied.
A centipede bursts from a side pocket and bites your hand. You shake it off and grab what coins you can.

choices.label: Check for hidden compartments
choices.description: Adventurers often hide their best finds.

outcomes.text: Your fingers find a false bottom! A stash of gold glints inside.
The hidden pocket holds a few coins and a faded map — worthless, but the gold is real.
A needle trap springs from the lining! Whoever hid this didn't want it found.
You leave the dead man's things where they lie. Some finds aren't worth the trouble.
